fact: UNECA's February 2025 verification report confirms that Kenya's Annual Vital Statistics Report for 2023 (births and deaths from civil registration, with causes of death) was produced and available online with a one-year lag, and that the Annual Agricultural Report 2023/24 was available online, both under the programme's improved availability of administrative data indicator.
title: Verification Report - Final: Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results, for the Republic of Kenya, February 2025
publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (UNECA)
